title: Ammi Thak Gayi Thi... Phir Ali Aur Zara Ne Kya Kiya? 🥹 | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Ammi kaam karte karte thak gayi thi... Ali aur Zara ne kya kiya? 🥹 Dadu ne sikhaya ki sabse zyada achhe sulook ka haqdaar kaun hai! 🤲

📖 Hadith:
Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ki ek shakhs ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha: "Mere achhe sulook ka sabse zyada haqdaar kaun hai?" Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tumhari maa." Usne poocha: "Phir kaun?" Farmaya: "Tumhari maa." Usne poocha: "Phir kaun?" Farmaya: "Tumhari maa." Usne poocha: "Phir kaun?" Farmaya: "Tumhare abba."
— Sahih Bukhari 5971, Sahih Muslim 2548 (Sahih)

✅ Ammi ki madad karo
✅ Maa-baap ki khidmat se Allah khush hota hai
